text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Are you nervous, Rice? You look tense.
Are you
okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, um... Well...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I just... really want to catch up with
Bourbon
today...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... as soon as I saw her, I froze up... I
don't
know if I have what it takes to win.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Of course you do!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You've got this! I mean, you trained so
hard you
practically wore your shoes
down to tatters!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And even if you don't win, today will
help fuel
your drive to win next time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, that's what I think about
before every
race. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, basically, you'll be fine! You'll be
absolutely
fine, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Drawn in by Matikanetannhauser's smile,
Rice
Shower's expression slowly begins
to relax.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Thank you! I'm going to
try my
hardest!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, no. I'm sorry! You're running today
too, yet
here I am going on about
Bourbon...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, no! I totally get it. It's Bourbon,
after all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, speak of the devil! There she is! Go
throw
down the gauntlet!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Throw down the gauntlet?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Words have power! Go on, now!
Go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Why is Tannhauser hiding over there?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Uuuuuh, um... Hey, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
L-let's have a... a good race today! I'm
going to
catch up to you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Rice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon firmly shakes Rice
Shower's
trembling hand.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to a good race as
well. I won't
let you beat me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's it! Great job, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
She's grown so much since I started
watching her
at the Satsuki Sho. It's just
so moving!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I almost forgot, but she also hid at the
entrance
of the runners' tunnel before
the Satsuki Sho
when Mihono Bourbon
was psyching herself up for
the race.
choice_data_list: どうしていつも隠れるんだ？
どうしていつも隠れるの？

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? I just, you know...
didn't
wanna get in the way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You know how rivals shake hands at the
climax of
a movie?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's not a moment for an ordinary gal
like me
to barge in on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's a skilled runner who's got a very
real chance
at winning.
choice_data_list: 君は普通の一般人じゃないよ
貴方は普通の一般人じゃないよ
choice_data_list_en: You're not just an ordinary person.
You're no ordinary person, you know.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you and your silver tongue. I've
heard about
parents being blind to their
children's faults, but
not trainers.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that doesn't matter right now!
More
importantly...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser suddenly thrusts
her right
hand out and starts grabbing
the air.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Right about... here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm doing an air handshake!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey! What's with that look?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Come on! We need enthusiasm if we're
going to
live up to the director's
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I may just be an ordinary Umamusume,
but the
director has high hopes for me,
so...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's just, I know this is a little late,
but I just
realized something...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Why does she have high hopes for me? Why not Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If she's looking for someone to guide
others,
wouldn't Bourbon be the better
choice? She's
guiding Rice, after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever! Today I need to
concentrate on
the race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With so many things to think about... the

Japanese Derby begins!
